### Mastercard to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conference


August 27, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s25.q4cdn.com/479285134/files/doc_news/Mastercard-to-Participate-in-Upcoming-Investor-Conference-2026.pdf)


PURCHASE, N.Y.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Mastercard Incorporated (NYSE: MA) today announced its participation in the following investor conference:


On Thursday, September 10, Ling Hai, chief financial officer, will present at the *Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference* in San Francisco, CA. The discussion will begin at 7:25 p.m. Eastern Time and last for approximately 35 minutes.


There will be a live audio webcast of the discussion and replay will be archived for 30 days at[investor.mastercard.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.mastercard.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54595733&newsitemid=20260827243671&lan=en-US&anchor=investor.mastercard.com&index=1&md5=930a37c114bf5d12aaeb26adc84c84ed) .


**About Mastercard Incorporated (NYSE: MA),**[www.mastercard.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mastercard.com&esheet=54595733&newsitemid=20260827243671&lan=en-US&anchor=www.mastercard.com&index=2&md5=536d17ea98d30f56d8960fe284e43868)


Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re building a resilient economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.
